macro.reason: Capped at 0.25, below the engine's 0.35 (RISK-OFF, score -1, VIX 36.9 intraday, 11.7% of universe above MA50, SPY -5.1% vs MA200, QQQ -10.2% vs MA200). Three sourced things the price gauge does not see: (1) the Fed is tightening into the drawdown - held 3.75-4.00% on Oct 28, minutes show confidence in a December hike, CME FedWatch ~95% for +25bp on Dec 9 (Kalshi 77-91%) with a January hike also being priced; Oct core CPI +0.3% m/m vs +0.2% expected; 10Y 5.085% / 30Y 5.426% on Nov 19 (10Y ~4.94-4.98% on Nov 20 on safe-haven bid) so the house 30Y>=5% gate is on. Event risk inside the holding window lands in a holiday-thinned tape: PCE + GDP Nov 25, payrolls Dec 4, FOMC Dec 9, CPI Dec 10. The driver is a trend change in the AI-capex leadership (three-plus weeks of selling since late Oct, S&P in correction, Nasdaq YTD gains erased) with shocks layered on top (Nvidia CEO resignation Nov 12, $68bn+ Anthropic IPO supply Nov 19 then a steep day-two fall), not a one-day shock, despite strong reported earnings (Q3 blended EPS growth 31.9%, NVDA beat and guided $130bn).

regime_assessment: RISK-OFF confirmed and I judge it a trend change in AI-capex leadership rather than a transient shock. Engine (intraday snapshot 2026-11-20): SPY 693.00, -9.3% 1m, -8.8% vs MA50, -5.1% vs MA200, -11.1% off high; QQQ 612.82, -13.0% 1m, -13.8% vs MA50, -10.2% vs MA200, -19.3% off high; VIX 36.87; breadth 11.7% above MA50; all five checks fail. Timeline (sourced): selling began late Oct (Oct 30 run log: Nasdaq -2.86%, INTC -29%, 'Alphabet shock'); Oct CPI Nov 10 hot on core (+0.3% vs +0.2%); Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned Nov 12 amid a board investigation, CFO Kress interim, NVDA lowest close since Jul 2025 by Nov 16; NVDA Q3 FY27 on Nov 17 beat ($115.8bn rev, Q4 guide $130bn +/-3%) and did not stop the selling; Anthropic IPO priced $83 (~$1.5tn, >=$68bn raised) and listed Nov 19, then fell hard on day two (Nov 20) with Nasdaq down ~3.4-5% and S&P ~2-3.5% intraday depending on timestamp; 58% of Nasdaq-100 members reported in bear markets. Macro backdrop is hostile, not supportive: the Fed is in a hiking posture (Dec 9 hike ~95% priced), 10Y ~5%, 30Y ~5.3-5.4%, dollar firm, gold liquidated. Fundamentals are the one positive: Q3 blended S&P EPS growth 31.9% (FactSet Nov 13), 84% beat rate but the smallest aggregate surprise (2.7%) since Q4 2022. House cross-asset confirmations are all negative: KOSPI -5.2% to 4,869.96 on Nov 20 (lowest close since Jan 16; was 5,730 on Oct 30); Hang Seng ~22,411, ~20% off its Jan 29 peak; BTC $58-61.7k, lowest since early July (was ~$77k on Oct 30), record IBIT outflow. Per PLAYBOOKS, QQQ<MA50 switches to the bottom-fishing basket (7/14/15) only; trend-basket entries are off. The market_internals_2026-10-01 files are stale and were ignored; run_log_2026-10-30 was used for background only and its figures re-verified or superseded above.
